newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Unrest spreads to Tirana, north, airport closed.
newsitem.headline: Unrest spreads to Tirana, north, airport closed.

text.p: Unrest sweeping Albania reached the capital Tirana early on Thursday as the military academy was looted of weapons during the night.

In the northern city of Shkoder, which has been untouched by the armed rebellion springing from the south, local residents reported that five people had been killed during the night. Tirana airport was reported to be closed.
For the first time since the rebellion sparked by anger over failed savings schemes erupted last month, shooting could be heard clearly in Tirana as newly acquired arms were fired in celebration.
Staff of international airlines reported that Tirana airport was closed, hampering the evacuation of some Western embassy employees and their families ordered by their governments.

The closure was also likely to block the arrival of a European mediation team headed by former Austrian leader Franz Vranitzky which was due to arrive in Tirana on Thursday to renew efforts to end the unres.
The new developments came only a few hours after Albania's new prime minister, Bashkim Fino, announced an all-party government he hopes can restore order and appealed for calm and reconciliation.
